'''Conrad Gall''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the leader of [[Dagger Wing]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
Around [[3641 BBY]], Gall and the rest of Dagger Wing were still imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] when the Empire led a full-scale assault on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], and they aided the Republic security forces in trying to secure the facility.
